messages.subject: [R GSoC] Final evaluations are open!
messages.body_plain:
All,

Final evaluations for GSoC 2018 are open!

Students:

You should be finishing up this week.  Polishing, documenting, testing,
cleaning up last little things, and so on.  Of course, we sincerely
hope that you stick around after GSoC, as many of our best mentors and
community contributors are former GSoC students.  That said, we need to
evaluate you on the project completed in the program timeline.

Students have a mentor evaluation, and a code submission which must be
completed.  Failure to complete either of these elements will result in
your not getting paid.  So please do it.

Mentors:

Only one mentor from each project team can complete and submit the
final evaluation. Evaluations are open for a little more than a week.
On Sunday, I will be reviewing any outstanding evaluations and
contacting the relevant mentor teams.  On Monday, if things are still
outstanding, We will have to fail your students for having absent
mentors.  Thanks for making sure we don't get to that point.  Google
will penalize organizations for missing evaluations.

As always, if you have any issues or concerns, please email Toby and me
as soon as possible, so that we can help.

Google's deadlines are firm (computers are like that), so please get
things done with plenty of time in advance so we can address any
issues.

Regards,

Brian

--
Brian G. Peterson

messages.subject: Re: [R GSoC] Final evaluations are open!
messages.body_plain:
All,

I misunderstood the timeline, I'm sorry.  Things have changed somewhat
this year from prior years.

*Student* Evaluations and final project submission are open *now*!

This process for Students closes on August 14th.

At that point, and apparently only then, *Mentor* final evaluations
open.  If Students have not completed their final evaluation and
submission, they will be automatically failed by Google.  Assuming that
students have completed their tasks, then the mentor teams will be able
to fill out the final project evaluations based on the submission.

*Mentor* final evaluations will run from August 14-21.

Results will be announced by Google to the Students on August 22nd.  It
is important to note that, as in prior years, program rules reserve
this final announcement to Google.  While you should be communicating
frequently with your students, and should be aware of all outstanding
tasks, expectations, etc. so that there are no surprises, the actual
announcement comes from Google directly to the student.

Sorry for any confusion.  As always, please contact Toby and me if you
have any questions.

Regards,

Brian
